passages.provision_quote: “assault weapon” also means any of the following: (1) A semiautomatic, centerfire rifle that does not have a fixed magazine but has any one of the following: (A) A pistol grip that protrudes conspicuously beneath the action of the weapon.
passages.note: Amends Penal Code Section 30515 to close the fixed-magazine loophole, expanding which semiautomatic rifles and pistols are banned as assault weapons.
Senate floor final-passage vote on SB 880; McGuire voted Aye.
passages.actor_quote: Ayes Allen, Beall, Block, De León, Glazer, Hall, Hancock, Hernandez, Hertzberg, Hill, Hueso, Jackson, Lara, Leno, Leyva, Liu, McGuire, Mendoza, Mitchell, Monning, Pan, Pavley, Wieckowski, Wolk

rows.reasoning: McGuire voted Aye on final passage of SB 880 (2015-2016), a single-subject bill whose operative section amends Penal Code Section 30515 to close the fixed-magazine loophole, expanding the definition of banned assault weapons while leaving other firearms untouched. This matches 'Ban semi-automatic assault-style weapons, while allowing other firearms' and excludes the total-ban and universal-background-check rungs.
